d:
Famously called the 'pearl in the necklace of the forts in India' by Babar, the Gwalior fort holds some of the darkest secrets of the Mughal empire. Watch this video to uncover the horrors that happened in the underbelly of this majestic fort.
Gvaliyar fort, babar ne jise bharat ke kilon se bane har ka moti kaha, vahan dabe hue hain mugal samrajy ke kaee bare raz. is vidiyo men dekhie ki is khubsurat kile ki divaron ke pichhe chhipe hain kaun se bhayavah rahasy |
